title: SpO2 drop
task: Pulse oximeter: 6 SpO2 readings over 30 s -> desaturation yes/no.
signal: 6 SpO2 readings (one per 5 s, 4-bit as 100 minus SpO2 %); the event is a dip of 4-10 points with partial recovery from a random onset; 20 % of normal windows carry a one-sample motion-artefact drop.
model_size: 8 rounds x depth 3 (8 trees), binary, TreeLUT w_feature=4, w_tree=3; input 6 x 4-bit
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
